Name: Boss Battle
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
Boss Battle 0.10.0

The elevator at the mine entrance now leads to four boss arenas. Boss Battle is currently in beta, with more bosses planned. In the first three arenas, head north to trigger the boss intro. When the boss title appears, press a button to begin.

Slime King — Dodge the knights’ charges and the king’s landing slam. Your first victory earns the Slime Scepter. The included guide explains how to summon the two knights to fight, chop trees, or mine alongside you.

Bat Lord — Watch for dives, sound waves, and bat swarms. Your first victory earns the Echo Necklace. Equip it in the hat slot to scan for forage, mine ladders, and buried caches.

Void Squad — Face the Void Brute, Void Marksman, and Void Shaman together. Each time one falls, the survivors enter their next phase. Defeat the squad to earn the Void Core, then hold and use it to unlock Void Travel, Void Ward, and Void Shockwave.

Crystalback Crab — New in 0.10.0. Choose the Crystal Seam Chamber at the elevator, follow the tracks north, then turn right into the quarry. Strike the large crystal three times with your pickaxe to awaken the crab. When it drops an ice crystal and a chunk of iron ore, break one to decide which shell it takes. Your first victory earns the Mine Crab Whistle. Use it to call a little crab that can carry up to 12 stacks of items back to your farm, once per farmer per day.

Requirements and installation
For Stardew Valley 1.6.15. Requires SMAPI 4.1.10 or later and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
Extract the Boss Battle folder into Mods with both Runtime and Content inside. When updating, move the old Boss Battle folder outside Mods before extracting the new version. To keep your settings, copy your old Runtime/config.json into the new Runtime folder.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese. Custom artwork was created with AI assistance. Feedback and bug reports are welcome!


Boss Battle 0.10.0（简体中文）

矿井大厅的电梯现在可以通往四个 Boss 场地。模组目前为测试版，后续会陆续加入更多 Boss。前三场挑战进入场地后向北走即可触发登场演出，看到 Boss 名称后按键开战。

史莱姆王 — 躲开两名骑士的冲锋，留意史莱姆王跃起后的落地震击。首胜可获得史莱姆权杖。随包指南介绍了如何召唤这两名骑士，让它们帮你战斗、砍树或采矿。

蝙蝠领主 — 留意俯冲、声波和成群袭来的蝙蝠。首胜可获得回音项链。将它装备在帽子栏，即可用声呐寻找采集物、矿梯和埋藏的宝箱。

虚空小队 — 同时迎战虚空狂徒、虚空狙击手和虚空萨满。每击败一名成员，剩下的成员就会进入下一阶段。击败小队可获得虚空核心，手持并使用即可解锁虚空穿梭、虚空护体和虚空震荡。

裂晶巨蟹 — 0.10.0 新增。在电梯选择裂晶矿室，沿矿轨向北，再右转进入采掘场。用镐子敲击中央的大晶石三次，即可唤醒巨蟹。它震落冰晶和铁矿时，击碎其中一块，就能决定它接下来披上哪种矿壳。首胜可获得矿蟹哨，吹响后能召来小矿蟹帮你把物品运回农场，每人每天一趟，每趟最多 12 组。

运行要求与安装
适用于《星露谷物语》1.6.15。需要 SMAPI 4.1.10 或更高版本，以及 Content Patcher 2.9.0 或更高版本。可选装通用模组配置菜单（Generic Mod Config Menu）。
将 Boss Battle 文件夹解压到游戏的 Mods 目录，保留其中的 Runtime 和 Content 两个文件夹。更新时，先将旧版 Boss Battle 文件夹移出 Mods，再解压新版。如需保留设置，可将旧版的 Runtime/config.json 复制到新版 Runtime 文件夹。

支持简体中文和英文。自定义美术素材采用 AI 辅助制作。欢迎反馈游玩体验或报告问题！
